title: AGENTS.md (open format specification site)
relevance_note: Defines cross-agent conventions for where to place project policy/instructions and states precedence and conflict resolution rules.
reason_included: Open-format doctrine for instruction placement and conflict resolution (closest file wins; user prompt overrides).

claim_snippets.claim_text: The closest AGENTS.md to the edited file wins when instructions conflict; explicit user chat prompts override everything.
Agents read the nearest AGENTS.md in the directory tree so subprojects can have tailored instructions via nested AGENTS.md files.
If testing commands are listed in AGENTS.md, the agent will attempt to execute relevant programmatic checks and fix failures before finishing the task.
